summary: Source review confirms the homepage random-teacher action is history-dependent: public:random-teacher chooses nonempty journey.matches.items, otherwise runtime.snapshot().demo.publicProfiles (checkpoint/vendor/hh/src/public-controller.mjs:699-704). Its only rendered caller is the home tile (public-site.mjs:33); app.mjs delegates data-event clicks directly to controller dispatch (137-174). Directory search intentionally computes matches from runtime profiles constrained by selected school hierarchy and query (public-controller.mjs:509-527), so reusing that view state makes a Home-wide random-teacher action silently depend on a previous directory search. Narrow correction: select from runtime publicProfiles for the homepage action regardless of matches; leave directory matching/filter state and profile route behavior unchanged. Acceptance: with a nonempty filtered directory subset and more than one runtime public profile, dispatching the home event may navigate only to a profile present in runtime publicProfiles, including profiles outside the old subset; repeating with empty matches continues using the runtime list; a separate explicit directory search still returns only profiles matching its filters. No new random UI or broader directory semantics are warranted. Falsifier: none found in actual renderer/callers/tests; no product intent or label specifies that Home's action should sample last-search results. Existing renderer test asserts button presence only; no controller random-teacher assertion was found. This is a source-only finding; no fix, test/build, fixture execution, or product writes were performed.
